data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 时间机器旁的禁断试验
data.description: 电话微波炉发出低沉的蜂鸣，昏暗的实验室内只有仪表盘微弱的光芒。红莉栖坐在工作台边沿，双腿微启挂在对方腰侧，散开的白大褂与凌乱的衬衫勾勒出极致的娇媚。
data.location: cluttered lab workbench surrounded by glowing vacuum tubes and oscilloscopes
data.action: 红莉栖坐在工作台边沿，双腿微启挂在对方腰侧，散开的白大褂与凌乱的衬衫勾勒出极致的娇媚
data.lighting: vibrant neon amber and cyan nixie tube numeric glow flickering in darkness
data.promptProse: Perched on the edge of the cluttered laboratory workbench late at night, Kurisu lets her short white lab coat fall open over her disheveled white shirt and loosened red tie as she wraps her stockinged legs around her partner's waist. Flushing deeply with parted lips in the dim room, she clings close while glowing amber nixie tubes and cyan oscilloscope traces flicker across the dark equipment behind them.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the laboratory workbench edge with her white lab coat and shirt parted open over her black thighhighs, Kurisu hooks her legs around her partner's waist in flushed intimacy. Glowing amber nixie tubes and cyan oscilloscope traces illuminate the dark lab behind them.
data.nsfwProse: Her tailored white lab coat hangs wide open over her unbuttoned white shirt and loosened red tie, with dark shorts and sheer black thighhighs framing her parted legs on the workbench.
